newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Schroders revise up Telecel profit outlook.
newsitem.headline: Schroders revise up Telecel profit outlook.

text.p: Schroders Securities said it had revised upwards its forecast for Portuguese mobile telephone operator Telecel-Comunicacoes Pessoais 1997 profits but it said the stock was overvalued at current prices.
"We have upgraded our forecasts significantly to reflect a more aggressive outlook on growth and expect 14.4 billion escudo net income for 1997," Schroders said.
It recommended Telecel as a long-term hold but said it was overvalued at its current market price of around 14,800 escudos per share.
"Telecel is worth 12,000 a share. Even on these upgraded forecasts Telecel remains the only European mobile stock that trades at a premium to DCF valuation."

Schroders said Telecel's earnings would continue to grow at or above 20 percent for the next three years but would settle down thereafter as the growth in the mobile phone market slowed and competition increased.

"Given the current high growth characteristics of the company, the downside risk at today's price is small if one is willing to take a long enough investment view. However, on a medium term horizon there is a strengthening case to take some profits."
At 1445 GMT Telecel stock stood at 14,850 escudos, down 100, on volume of 32,468. -- Lisbon editorial +(351-1) 3538254
